name: Thunder Software Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Thunder Software Technology Co.,Ltd. provides operating systems and on-device AI products and technologies in China, Europe, the United States, Japan, and internationally. The company offers pre and post silicon products; Smart Robotics Solutions, such as high, medium, and low computing power system on module and robot brain solutions; Edge AI station, IoT harbor, AIoT turnkey platform products; and Kanzi-3D engine and HMI toolchain.
